The '''Black Hole''' was a region of the [[Labor Valley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that served as an industrial site for the processing and storage of [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]]. This volatile and toxic substance was a vital fuel for lightspeed travel.

During the [[Galactic War]], Corellia itself was invaded by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] which brought about the end of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] that had led to a tense peace with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, losses sustained by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] at [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] and [[Denova]] led to their forces being fragmented which in turn forced them to pull away from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. At the time, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Adele Konya]] who was stationed at [[Horizon Outpost]] at the edge of the Black Hole was in charge of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] forces in the region. She was charged with sabotaging the Black Hole in order to deprive the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] fleets of vital fuel and leaving the planet isolated while the Imperial forces entered into a full retreat.

However, she faced opposition from [[Council]]or [[Harmon Torvix|Torvix]] who had recruited a criminal army and had taken the Black Hole facility. As a result, General Konya was forced to recruit an Imperial official with taking back the site from Torvix's forces.

==Behind the scenes==
The Black Hole is a Daily Mission Area in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' that was first added in Game Update 1.2: Legacy on [[April 12]], [[2012]]. The game's first Daily Area, it serves as a continuation of the world storyline for Corellia.<ref name="1.2">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1.2.0/legacy|text=Game Update 1.2: Legacy Patch Notes}}</ref>
